# RQ1 — Differential expression

Which genes are differentially expressed between patients with complete response and patients with progressive disease following anti-PD-L1 treatment?

### Load data and packages

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(DESeq2)
library(fgsea)
library(msigdbr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(pheatmap)

# Load prepared data
prepared <- readRDS("../data/processed/imvigor210_prepared.rds")
```


### DESeq2 analysis
Differential expression analysis between responders/non-responder using DESeq2, and identify significantly differentially expressed genes.

```{r}
dds <- prepared$dds
dds
```
```{r}
# Extract results (NR is reference, positive LFC = higher in R)
res <- results(dds, alpha = 0.05)
summary(res)
```
```{r}
# Rank genes for GSEA
ranked_genes <- res$stat
names(ranked_genes) <- rownames(res)
ranked_genes <- ranked_genes[!is.na(ranked_genes)]

# remove empty string names
ranked_genes <- ranked_genes[names(ranked_genes) != ""]
```

```{r}
# GSEA with MSigDB GO Biological Process
gene_sets <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", collection = "C5", subcollection = "BP")
gene_sets <- split(x = gene_sets$gene_symbol, f = gene_sets$gs_name)

set.seed(42)
fgsea_res <- fgsea(pathways = gene_sets, stats = ranked_genes, nPermSimple = 10000)
```

```{r}
# Look at top results
fgsea_res |>
  arrange(padj) |>
  head(20)
```

```{r}
# Top upregulated pathways in responders (positive NES)
fgsea_res |>
  filter(padj < 0.05, NES > 0) |>
  arrange(padj) |>
  head(10)
```

```{r}
# Top downregulated pathways in responders (negative NES)
fgsea_res |>
  filter(padj < 0.05, NES < 0) |>
  arrange(padj) |>
  head(10)
```


### Results & interpretation


Visualize the results using e.g. volcano plots and heatmaps of selected genes.
Investigate the biological functions of differentially expressed genes and discuss their potential relevance to immunotherapy response.

```{r}
# Volcano plot
res_df <- as.data.frame(res) |>
  mutate(significant = padj < 0.05 & !is.na(padj))

ggplot(res_df, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = -log10(padj), color = significant)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("grey", "limegreen")) +
  labs(x = "Log2 Fold Change", y = "-Log10 Adjusted P-value",
       title = "Differential expression: R vs NR") +
  theme_minimal()
```
```{r}

# Get top 30 significant DEGs by adjusted p-value
top_genes <- as.data.frame(res) |>
  filter(!is.na(padj), padj < 0.05, abs(log2FoldChange) > 1) |>
  arrange(padj) |>
  head(30)

# Extract TPM values for top genes
tpm_matrix <- prepared$tpm[rownames(top_genes), ]

# Log transform for visualization
tpm_log <- log2(tpm_matrix + 1)

# Annotation for columns (samples)
annotation <- data.frame(BOR = prepared$clinical$BOR)
rownames(annotation) <- colnames(tpm_log)

# Plot
pheatmap(tpm_log,
         annotation_col = annotation,
         show_rownames = TRUE,
         show_colnames = FALSE,
         scale = "row",
         clustering_method = "complete",
         main = "Top 30 DEGs: R vs NR")
```
```{r}
# Order samples by BOR
sample_order <- order(prepared$clinical$BOR)

pheatmap(tpm_log[, sample_order],
         annotation_col = annotation,
         show_rownames = TRUE,
         show_colnames = FALSE,
         scale = "row",
         cluster_cols = FALSE,
         breaks = seq(-3, 3, length.out = 101),
         main = "Top 30 DEGs: R vs NR")
```

### Limitations

Discuss the limitations of the analysis, including potential confounding factors and why differential expression does not necessarily imply a causal role in treatment response.
